name: Binod Kumar / विनोद कुमार `बल्लोपुरी`

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Binod Kumar writes Hindi poetry under the pen name Ballopuri. His Kabita Live poem हवा सर्दी की.. begins with the sensations of changing seasons: cold that makes the body tremble, summer’s restlessness, and spring awakening memories of a beloved.

Across three short stanzas, wind becomes more than weather. It shifts direction like circumstance, sustains everyone through breath, and finally turns into a figure for influence and power. The repeated opening gives the poem a conversational rhythm as it moves between nature and social observation.
